privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This blog is read without an account or comments, and collects visit statistics to improve its articles and usability. If you prefer not to be measured, turn collection off for this browser under ‘Turn off collection’ below.

analytics.heading: Visit statistics (Google Analytics)
analytics.body: The blog sends the visited page address and previous page address (both without query parameters or hash), the page title, and events such as language changes, shares, category and tag selections, and whether a search was made. Search terms themselves are never sent. Google Analytics also processes device and browser information and an approximate location derived from the IP address, and stores cookies starting with _ga.

heatmaps.heading: Heatmaps and session replay (Microsoft Clarity)
heatmaps.body: Heatmaps and session replays are not currently collected. Microsoft Clarity has been disabled to prevent it from collecting search terms contained in page addresses and other URLs.

processors.heading: Processors and international transfer
processors.body: Visit statistics currently collected are processed by Google LLC and may be stored on servers in other countries, including the United States. Advertising storage and ad personalization signals are not used.

retention.heading: Retention
retention.body: Data is kept for the retention period configured in each service and is then deleted by that service.

optOut.heading: Turn off collection
optOut.body: Use the button below to turn visit statistics off or back on for this browser. Turning them off deletes the Google Analytics cookies and stops sending data. Your choice is stored only in this browser. If the browser cannot save your choice, collection still stops immediately in this tab, but the choice may not be kept when you reopen the page.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: Send questions about this notice to the email address below.
